user.title: HouseFly
user.description: Pick sensors the fly can 'feel' and lights/covers/switches it can 'control'. Optional camera → real 16×16 ommatidia (Pillow). Pure toy reservoir — not a real fly brain. ⚠️ Start with 1-2 spare bulbs, NOT the whole house! (Away? peek via vome.io — optional.)

data.input_entities: 🧠 What the fly can SEE (1–32 sensors)
data.output_entities: 💡 What the fly can CONTROL (1–32 outputs)
data.whole_house: ⚠️ WHOLE HOUSE MODE (auto-selects ALL lights/switches/covers — confirmation required!)

confirm_whole_house.title: ⚠️ WHOLE HOUSE MODE — ARE YOU SURE?!
confirm_whole_house.description:
This will give the fruit fly control over **{output_count} devices** (lights, switches, covers, fans) across your home. The fly will randomly flicker, toggle, open, and close things based on a 256-neuron toy reservoir. **This is pretty insane.** Safety limits: tick ≥15s, intensity ≤0.4. Capped at {max_outputs} max outputs.

**Recommended:** Start with 1-2 spare lamps, NOT this.

**Still want chaos?** Check the box below.

data.confirm_chaos: ☑️ I understand this can thrash lights/covers/switches and I'm ready for the chaos
